architecture.pattern: Clean Architecture with Event-Driven IPC Service & Unidirectional Data Flow (MVI/MVVM)
layers: Presentation Layer: Accessible Android Activity & WebView UI with W3C WAI-ARIA 1.3 live announcements for TalkBack and Jieshuo
Bridge & IPC Layer: Local RFC 6455 WebSocket Server (127.0.0.1:8765) & Termux RUN_COMMAND Intent Dispatcher with PendingIntent callback capture
Automation & Accessibility Layer: Android AccessibilityService (API 34) managing active window node inspection, gesture dispatching, screenshot capture, and node action execution
Domain & Security Layer: Loopback socket binding, permission validation (com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND, BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE), and rate-limited command execution
architecture.a11y_strategy: Strict compliance with WCAG 2.2 AAA & W3C WAI-ARIA. Direct screen reader integration for TalkBack & CSR/Jieshuo. Zero emoji clutter. All custom UI components declared with explicit semantic roles, focusable tabindex, and aria-live="polite" status regions. Dynamic event narration for active window changes and Termux command execution results.
architecture.persistence: EncryptedSharedPreferences / DataStore for bridge port configuration, allowed command whitelists, and local IPC auth tokens

requirements.title: Android Accessibility Service Core Implementation
requirements.description: Implement AntigravityAccessibilityService extending AccessibilityService with android:canRetrieveWindowContent="true", android:canPerformGestures="true", and android:canTakeScreenshot="true". Provide getRootInActiveWindow() and getRootInActiveWindow_prefetching(int) for low-latency hierarchy traversal, performAction(int, Bundle) on AccessibilityNodeInfo, performGlobalAction(int) for system navigation, and dispatchGesture(GestureDescription, GestureResultCallback, Handler) for tactile gesture dispatching.
requirements.verification_criteria: Service successfully binds, connects via onServiceConnected(), dumps hierarchy node tree without ANR, and dispatches back/home/recents global actions.

requirements.title: Termux RUN_COMMAND Intent Integration
requirements.description: Implement TermuxBridgeManager adhering to com.termux.RUN_COMMAND specifications. Dispatch explicit intents to com.termux/com.termux.app.RunCommandService with EXTRA_COMMAND_PATH, EXTRA_ARGUMENTS, EXTRA_WORKDIR, and EXTRA_BACKGROUND=true. Attach PendingIntent with FLAG_MUTABLE (API 31+) to capture asynchronous execution results (stdout, stderr, exitCode, errCode) without payload truncation.
requirements.verification_criteria: Successful round-trip command execution in Termux background, returning exitCode 0 and captured stdout back to the companion app.

requirements.title: Local Duplex WebSocket IPC Server
requirements.description: Embed Java-WebSocket WebSocketServer bound exclusively to 127.0.0.1:8765 running in a dedicated background executor thread. Provide real-time bidirectional JSON-RPC messaging between Termux Python/CLI agents and the companion Android app. Support actions: ping, get_window_tree, click_node, input_text, swipe, take_screenshot, and run_termux_command.
requirements.verification_criteria: WebSocket client in Termux connects to ws://127.0.0.1:8765, sends get_window_tree command, and receives complete JSON hierarchy.

requirements.title: Accessible Companion UI & WebView ARIA Integration
requirements.description: Build MainActivity with integrated WebView adhering to W3C WAI-ARIA and TalkBack/Jieshuo standards. WebSettings configured with JavaScript enabled and safe JavascriptInterface bridge (window.AntigravityBridge). Dynamic logs and service statuses stream to aria-live="polite" container with accessible names, clear keyboard navigation, and zero decorative emoji noise.
requirements.verification_criteria: TalkBack and Jieshuo read status updates cleanly without focus trapping, and JavascriptInterface calls trigger Android bridge actions safely.

requirements.title: Low-Latency Screenshot Acquisition
requirements.description: Implement takeScreenshot(DEFAULT_DISPLAY, Executor, TakeScreenshotCallback) available on API 30+ to capture screen buffers for vision-language models and CLI OCR agents without requiring MediaProjection permissions or root access.
requirements.verification_criteria: Screenshot callback returns valid HardwareBuffer, converted to JPEG/PNG bytes and transmitted via WebSocket or written to shared cache.

requirements.title: Self-Diagnostic Doctor & Health Check Engine
requirements.description: Provide internal DoctorDiagnosticEngine verifying: (1) Accessibility Service enablement status, (2) com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND grant status, (3) ~/.termux/termux.properties allow-external-apps flag, (4) WebSocket server port 8765 availability, and (5) TalkBack/Jieshuo active accessibility services.
requirements.verification_criteria: Diagnostic returns structured JSON report with actionable 3-part remediation instructions for any missing permission or misconfiguration.

requirements.title: Graceful Lifecycle Management & Signal Handling
requirements.description: Ensure AntigravityAccessibilityService and WebSocketServer handle lifecycle events (onDestroy, onUnbind, configuration changes) gracefully. Stop socket listeners, release active node references, clear PendingIntent receivers, and flush pending log buffers atomically.
requirements.verification_criteria: Zero memory leaks, socket address-in-use collisions on restart, or orphan background threads.

requirements.title: GitHub Actions Automated APK Build & Release Workflow
requirements.description: Provide .github/workflows/build-apk.yml configuring an Ubuntu runner with JDK 17, Android SDK Platform 34, and Gradle to automatically compile app-debug.apk and app-release.apk on push or workflow_dispatch, publishing downloadable APK artifacts to GitHub Releases.
requirements.verification_criteria: GitHub Actions workflow YAML syntax is valid and builds APK artifact without needing local Android SDK in Termux.

requirements.title: Hidden Server Architecture & Zero-Friction Automated Setup
requirements.description: Relocate Python web/chat server into hidden protected directory ~/.antigravity-server/ inside Termux. Bundle server.py and web/ into repository and APK assets. Provide one-line idempotent setup.sh script executing Termux permissions, package installations, port 7681 startup test, and culminating in agy installation.
requirements.verification_criteria: setup.sh executes end-to-end cleanly, hidden directory is populated, port 7681 is active, and Android app detects and recovers server state without user intervention.

requirements.title: Accessible In-App Authentication Wizard & PTY Subprocess Bridge
requirements.description: Implement an interactive, screen-reader accessible authentication flow directly within the companion app web UI and backend server.py. The backend spawns agy inside a pseudo-terminal (PTY) using Python pty.openpty() and os.login_tty() to intercept authentication states: (1) OAuth Authorization URL, (2) Prompt for authorization code, (3) Terms of Service & License acceptance (AcceptTermsOfService), and (4) Authentication success or failure. The Web UI exposes accessible semantic controls (open browser button, clean input field for authorization code with aria-label, and two-button agreement dialog for license acceptance) with live announcements (aria-live="polite"). The backend also provides /api/auth/status checking token validity via ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/antigravity-oauth-token, and /api/auth/logout to safely revoke or clear session credentials.
requirements.verification_criteria: Verification that /api/auth/status, /api/auth/start, /api/auth/input, /api/auth/accept_terms, and /api/auth/logout endpoints function properly, token validity is accurately reported, and the Web UI renders accessible controls compliant with WCAG 2.2 AAA without requiring raw CLI terminal interaction.

requirements.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) In-App Authentication & Token Pairing Engine
requirements.description: Provide in-app OAuth 2.0 / 2.1 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) and direct Bearer Token / API Key pairing for any MCP server. Support fetching user verification code/link, pasting authorization code/token to link the server, testing connection health, and persisting credentials atomically into ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json.
requirements.verification_criteria: Endpoints /api/mcp/auth/request_device, /api/mcp/auth/pair, and /api/mcp/auth/test return 200 with valid data, tokens are persisted atomically into mcp_config.json, and the accessible dialog renders screen-reader friendly controls with TalkBack/Jieshuo support.

requirements.title: Human-Grade UI Label Conciseness & Screen Reader Optimization
requirements.description: تنقيح وتلخيص كافة التسميات (Labels)، وأوصاف عناصر التحكم (ARIA descriptions / helper texts)، وعناوين البطاقات، وأزرار الواجهة في صفحة التطبيق (index.html). إزالة الحشو والرغي الطويل المصطنع ذي الطابع الآلي (AI-generated fluff & robotic phrasing)، واستبدالها بنصوص وتسميات بشرية، مباشرة، وموجزة تمنح مستخدم قارئ الشاشة (TalkBack / Jieshuo) تجربة سريعة وسلسة وتقلل العبء السمعي المعرفي بدون أي إخلال بدقة الوظيفة أو معايير WCAG 2.2 AAA.
requirements.verification_criteria: جميع التسميات والأوصاف في واجهة التطبيق أصبحت موجزة، صريحة، وطبيعية بشرية خالية من الحشو الآلي، مع اجتياز الفحص الآلي عبر validate_code.py.

requirements.title: Accessible Focus & Keyboard Navigation for Slash (/) and Mention (@) Menus
requirements.description: تحسين إمكانية الوصول لقوائم الإكمال التلقائي للأوامر السريعة (Slash Commands '/') وقائمة الإشارة والسياق (Mentions '@') في حقل الإدخال. إدارة تركيز قارئ الشاشة (TalkBack و Jieshuo) تلقائياً عند فتح القائمة، وتطبيق معايير W3C Combobox / Listbox (عبر aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant أو نقل التركيز المباشر)، وتوفير إمكانية التنقل السلس بالأسهم والسحب بين الأوامر وسماع اسم كل أمر ووظيفته بوضوح، واختياره بـ Enter أو إلغائه بـ Escape/Back، دون إجبار المستخدم على البحث بالتلمس اليدوي على الشاشة.
requirements.verification_criteria: بمجرد كتابة '/' أو '@' في حقل الإدخال يتم إشعار قارئ الشاشة صوتياً فوراً وينتقل التركيز تلقائياً أو يُدار بالأسهم مع قراءة العنصر النشط، ويعمل الاختيار والإلغاء بسلاسة دون الحاجة للمس الشاشة.

requirements.title: Multi-Trigger Support for Slash Commands (/) and Mentions (@) within Single Prompt
requirements.description: تمكين استدعاء واختيار أكثر من أمر سريع (Slash Command '/') أو إشارة سياق (Mention '@') داخل نفس الرسالة أو الطلب الواحد. معالجة القيد البرمجي الحالي في معالج الإدخال الذي يمنع انبثاق قائمة الاقتراحات بعد إدراج أول أمر أو عند كتابة الرمز في منتصف النص مسبوقاً بمسافة، وتطوير تتبع موضع المؤشر (Caret Tracking) ليسمح باختيار مهارات وأوامر متعددة في نفس الطلب بدون تعليق.
requirements.verification_criteria: إمكانية إدراج أمرين أو أكثر من أوامر السلاش أو الإشارات في نفس الرسالة مع فتح القائمة واختيار كل عنصر بنجاح في كل مرة يُكتب فيها الرمز.

requirements.title: Model-Adaptive Reasoning Effort Filtering & Guard for Claude Models
requirements.description: معالجة خطأ فشل تشغيل نماذج كلود (error: invalid model selection: --effort is not supported for model 'claude-sonnet-4-6'). تطبيق فحص دفاعي وتحقق ذكي في سيرفر الباك إند (server.py) والواجهة (index.html) للتحقق من توافق راية التفكير والاستدلال (--effort) مع النموذج المختار قبل تمريرها لـ agy CLI. استبعاد تمرير --effort تلقائياً لنماذج Anthropic Claude والنماذج غير الداعمة للتفكير الممتد، مع تحديث واجهة المستخدم لتعطيل قائمة الـ effort أو إخفائها بوضوح صوتي عند اختيار هذه النماذج.
requirements.verification_criteria: تشغيل نماذج Claude بنجاح دون أي خطأ invalid model selection، مع استبعاد راية --effort برمجياً للنماذج غير الداعمة وتعطيلها في الواجهة.

requirements.title: Permanent Release Keystore & In-Place Seamless APK Update Pipeline
requirements.description: إنشاء واعتماد مفتاح توقيع رقمي دائم وموحد (Permanent Android Release Keystore) لحزم الـ APK وتكوينه داخل Gradle و GitHub Actions CI/CD. يضمن هذا توقيع كافة التحديثات والإصدارات المستقبلية بنفس البصمة الرقمية الموثوقة (Consistent Signing Certificate)، مما يمكن المستخدمين من تثبيت التحديثات فوق الإصدار الحالي مباشرة (Seamless In-Place Update) دون أن يرفض نظام أندرويد التثبيت ودون الحاجة لحذف التطبيق وفقدان الإعدادات والصلاحيات.
requirements.verification_criteria: توليد ملف Keystore دائم وتضمينه في إعدادات signingConfigs داخل build.gradle، وتأكيد قدرة أندرويد على تثبيت الإصدار المحدث فوق الإصدار السابق بنجاح ودون خطأ تعارض التوقيع.

requirements.title: Android In-App OTA Update Manager (FileProvider, REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES, OkHttp streaming downloader, SemVer comparison)
requirements.description: Implement AppUpdateManager and native update pipeline for seamless in-app over-the-air updates. Query GitHub Releases API (https://api.github.com/repos/ahanafy41/antigravity-companion/releases/latest) with SemVer comparison against BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME. Download APK using OkHttp streaming response with byte-level progress reporting and atomic file replacement in cache directory. Configure androidx.core.content.FileProvider with res/xml/file_paths.xml and declare android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES in AndroidManifest.xml. Launch Intent.ACTION_VIEW with MIME type application/vnd.android.package-archive, FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION, and FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK to invoke system PackageInstaller. Provide runtime permission verification via PackageManager.canRequestPackageInstalls() and redirect to Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_UNKNOWN_APP_SOURCES when required.
requirements.verification_criteria: UpdateManager detects new GitHub release, downloads APK with accurate 0-100% progress events, generates valid FileProvider content:// URI, and triggers system package installer without crashing or throwing FileUriExposedException.

requirements.title: Accessible Update UI & AntigravityJsBridge (WAI-ARIA status, TalkBack narration, zero emoji, check for update button in drawer)
requirements.description: Integrate OTA update controls into the companion WebView UI and AntigravityJsBridge. Expose checkForUpdate(), startUpdateDownload(url), canInstallUnknownApps(), openInstallPermissionSettings(), and getAppVersion() to JavaScript. Add a dedicated 'التحقق من التحديثات' (Check for Updates) button inside the navigation drawer (#antigravity-drawer). Implement an accessible update status dialog / container with role="status", aria-live="polite", and WAI-ARIA progressbar (role="progressbar", aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin="0", aria-valuemax="100"). Provide clean, concise human-grade TalkBack and Jieshuo speech feedback announcing update availability, download progress milestones (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%), and installation prompts, strictly adhering to zero emoji clutter and WCAG 2.2 AAA accessibility standards.
requirements.verification_criteria: Check for updates button in drawer triggers native check, TalkBack announces update status and progress cleanly without emoji noise, progressbar updates ARIA attributes dynamically, and install flow launches smoothly from web UI.

entry_points.run: ./gradlew installDebug && adb shell am start -n com.antigravity.companion/.MainActivity
